title: Introduce curation workflow and changelog synthesis pipeline
author: Priya Malhotra
release_notes: Adds a human-in-the-loop curation workflow and an automated changelog synthesis pipeline that drafts release notes from model profile diffs and curator annotations. Backwards compatible metadata fields added; rollout gated by feature flag.
body: Summary: This PR introduces a composable curation workflow and a changelog synthesis pipeline for model onboarding. Aim: reduce manual effort for release notes while preserving curator oversight and traceability. Motivation: model profile diffs and manual curator comments have driven inconsistent changelogs and missed behavioral regressions in previous releases. This change stitches together: (1) a curator candidate queue + lightweight UI hooks, (2) a canonical curator annotation schema stored in model metadata, and (3) a changelog synthesis service that renders human-readable release notes from profile deltas and curator annotations. Design and approach: - New DB: 'curation_candidates' (lightweight rows: model_id, candidate_tag, reviewer_hint, priority, created_at). Implemented as an append-only table with retention policy; data surface kept minimal to avoid migration risk. - Metadata: introduces two optional model metadata fields: "curation.summary" and "curation.signoff", both string-typed; these are stored alongside existing profile blobs and default to empty. The loader is tolerant to missing fields. - Synthesis pipeline: server-side job 'synthesize_changelog' that: 1) computes profile delta between release candidates using existing profile fingerprints, 2) extracts metric anchors (latency, token cost, pass-rate-on-evals) and ranks deltas by user-facing risk, 3) merges curator annotations (if present) and drafts a concise changelog paragraph plus an impact bullet list. The draft is persisted as 'release_notes.draft' and surfaced to the curator queue in the UI for approval or edit. - CLI/Automation hooks: added two commands to the registry CLI: 'registry curate list-candidates' and 'registry synthesize-changelog --candidate <id>'. Both commands call the same backend endpoints as the UI and can be used by automation (release scripts) or human engineers. - UI: small set of react hooks + endpoint stubs that surface drafts and allow inline edits and signoff. The PR includes only the backend stubs and a minimal UI placeholder; follow-up will iterate on UX. Implementation details & commits: - Commit: add curation candidate table, migrations, and model APIs (pr:backend/curation-migration) - Commit: add profile-delta comparator and metric anchoring heuristics (pr:backend/delta-heuristics) - Commit: changelog synthesis service + persistence (pr:backend/changelog-synth) - Commit: registry CLI commands and docs (pr:cli/curation-commands) - Commit: API surface for UI + basic placeholder frontend (pr:ui/curation-placeholder) Files changed (high level): - migrations/20241108_add_curation_candidates.sql - backend/curation/service.py - backend/curation/synthesizer.py - backend/profiles/delta.py - cli/registry/curate.py - api/routes/curation.py - ui/curation/placeholder.tsx - docs/curation.md - tests/curation/test_synthesizer.py Migration and rollout plan: - Migration is additive and low-risk (adds an append-only table). Feature gated by 'curation_pipeline' feature flag. Default off for existing customers. - Rollout steps: enable for internal staging, run synthesis on last 3 releases to validate draft quality, invite internal curators to sign off, then enable for small subset of customers. Observability and metrics: - Added metrics: curation.candidates.created, synth.drafts.generated, synth.drafts.approved, synth.drafts.rejected, synth.latency_ms. - Logs include deterministic synthesis version and delta fingerprint so drafts are reproducible. Testing notes: - Unit tests for delta comparator and metric anchoring (tests/curation/test_synthesizer.py). - Integration test that runs CLI synthesize against a seeded candidate and asserts draft population. - End-to-end manual QA by curator team documented in docs/curation.md. Backwards compatibility: - No breaking changes to existing profile schema; new metadata fields optional. - CLI commands are opt-in. Related work & follow-ups: - Follow-up PR to wire full curator UI with rich diff visualization (ENG-3445). - Evaluation job to surface synthesized drafts into release pipelines and collect curator feedback telemetry (PM-121). Security & compliance: - Curator annotations are stored in the same encrypted model metadata store; KMS policies unchanged. - Audit hooks recorded for draft creation and signoff. Checklist: - [x] DB migration (add curation_candidates) - [x] Delta comparator and anchor heuristics - [x] Synthesis service + persistence - [x] CLI commands and docs - [x] Basic UI stubs and API endpoints - [x] Unit & integration tests - [x] Feature-flag gating and rollout docs
review_comments: Alan: please add a short migration rollback note and confirm table TTL. Author: added TTL of 90 days and noted in migration file. Marta: suggested including a sample synthesized draft in docs to set expectations; author added example in docs/curation.md. Diego: requested clearer metric names for anchoring; renamed synth.anchor_rank to synth.risk_rank and updated tests. Final: LGTM from all reviewers after small fixes.
